Maya L: Heads-up — kb page /guides/batch-routing has a broken internal link; link-checker is failing CI for the docs site. Error: 404 on /docs/runtime/kv-cache. Who can claim a quick PR?
docs-bot: link-checker found 1 broken link in build 4523 — /guides/batch-routing -> /docs/runtime/kv-cache (404). Log: https://ci.internal/build/4523 :warning:
Alex P: I can take it. If it's just a path fix I can sed it in a PR. pinging @Samir for a quick lint pass
Samir: ok. small nit — make sure to update codeowners frontmatter. Also check staging preview after the PR.
Maya L: @Alex P thanks. Minimal patch pattern: 
``
sed -i 's#/docs/runtime/kv-cache#/docs/serving/kv-cache#g' content/guides/batch-routing.md
```
please include the original path as a shortlink redirect if possible.
Alex P: Opening PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9876 — changed path and added frontmatter owner: eng-runtime. Ran local markdownlint and linkcheck (no failures).
ci-bot: link-checker/preview failed on first run due to stale cache, rerunning...
ci-bot: ✅ link-checker passed on rerun. markdownlint: 0 warnings. Preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/s/batch-routing
Maya L: awesome, thx! Please add 'eng-runtime' to CODEOWNERS if you can, else ping infra. :thumbsup:
Alex P: added it to frontmatter and updated CODEOWNERS in the PR. Marking as ready for review. cc @Samir
Samir: LGTM, merging once CI green.
ci-bot: Merge completed, build 4524 deployed to staging.
